title: The Stick Chose Him
narrationText:
Kai reaches the gayelle late, doubles still warm in his hand, and the whole yard hears the first drum call.

Nia watches the rhythm change as Papa Etienne places the bois in the dust and tells Kai to listen before he swings.

The stick answers before Kai does, and Malik sees the memory spark move through the grain.
